h1: AI agents and automations for support teams
answer: Support teams hand off the first draft: an AI agent writes each reply from what your business knows, and a desk tracks every request.
Every reply waits for a person to approve, change or decline it.

faqs.q: Will the AI make up answers?
faqs.a: Its instructions say to answer only from what it knows and to tell you when it cannot. You still read every draft before it goes.

faqs.q: Do I need a help desk for this?
faqs.a: No. A requests desk app in 50agents works straight from your Gmail. If you already use Zendesk or Freshdesk, the AI agent can work with their tickets.

faqs.q: Can it reply on its own for simple questions?
faqs.a: By default every reply asks first. You can give an AI agent more freedom later in its settings, one kind of action at a time.

faqs.q: What does it not do yet?
faqs.a: No live chat or phone: it works on email, and on tickets in apps like Zendesk and Freshdesk through their actions. It does not issue refunds or credits; anything that moves money asks you, and the reply only says what you have decided. A post to a Slack channel waits for your approval today, so urgent alerts are not instant.
